name: Joshua Garcia
bio: Joshua Espineli Garcia (born 07 October 1997) is a Filipino actor. He is best known for his roles in the films Barcelona: A Love Untold (2016), Vince & Kath & James (2016), Love You to the Stars and Back (2017), Block Z (2020), Ang Mga Kaibigan Ni Mama Susan (2023), and Un/Happy For You (2024). He is a four-time FAMAS nominee.
